name: Gulmohar Restaurant (Visamo Nalsarovar Resort)
signature_dish: Poolside multi-cuisine in a tree canopy
why_it_matters: The closest proper restaurant to Nalsarovar Bird Sanctuary — Visamo Nalsarovar Resort's in-house, fully AC Gulmohar restaurant on the Bavla-Nalsarovar State Highway. Wide menu (Continental, Punjabi, South Indian, Gujarati) and the only verifiable sit-down with consistent hygiene in the catchment, given the sanctuary itself has only makeshift seasonal stalls.
insider_tip: Sanctuary visit is winter-only (Nov-Feb) — combine a morning bird visit with a lunch back at the resort, ~15-20 km away. Inside the sanctuary, makeshift Gujju Kathiawadi stalls on islands serve thalis ~₹160 in season but hygiene is variable; eat there only at peak winter, not shoulder months.
signature_address: Visamo Nalsarovar Resort, State Highway Bavla, Kerala-Nalsarovar Road, Dahegamda, Bavla, Ahmedabad District 382220

name: Club Azzurro Resort Restaurant
why_it_matters: The other proper resort dining option near Nalsarovar — Club Azzurro Resort, listed on Hotels.com and tiket.com with a restaurant + 24-hour room service + outdoor pool + garden. Useful as a backup if Visamo is fully booked during winter migration peaks.
insider_tip: Less reviewed than Visamo so call before driving out — the kitchen scales down outside the winter season. Garden lawn is the better evening pick than the indoor restaurant.
signature_address: Club Azzurro Resort, Nalsarovar, Bavla, Ahmedabad District 382220
